notes.title: Pre-Alpha Gameplay Trailer Released
notes.notes:
[h1]Unveiling Early Development Gameplay | The Darkened Halls[/h1]

🌑 Prepare to step into the shadows with the first-ever gameplay trailer for '[i]The Darkened Halls[/i].' Join me, a solo developer, on a spine-chilling journey through a world of mystery, puzzles, and nightmarish creatures.

🔗 [b]Watch the Trailer:[/b] 
[previewyoutube=iJ9xQxsb0BY;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]🕹️ Gameplay Highlights:[/b]

Encounter nightmarish bosses in a psychological horror experience.
Solve intricate puzzles and uncover chilling secrets.
Face your fears armed with wits, not weapons.
Witness the relentless pursuit of formidable foes.
📢 [b]Note:[/b] This is early development footage, and '[i]The Darkened Halls[/i]' is a work in progress. Your feedback is crucial as I shape the final experience.

🌟 Thank you for your support! Subscribe to stay updated on the journey through the darkened halls.
